remarks: Experience effortless one-level living in this spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home at Candlelight Terrace. Fully updated and move-in ready, the interior features a brand-new kitchen with stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, and modern flooring throughout. Fresh paint, updated vanities, and new hardware complete the contemporary feel. Enjoy ultimate peace of mind with common charges that cover heat, hot water, flood insurance, and an on-site superintendent. This pet-friendly community offers lush gardens along the Rippowam River, an in-ground pool, and dedicated grilling areas. Complete with extra storage and ample parking, you're just minutes from the vibrant dining and shopping of downtown Stamford.
